method: Each named cascade player placed against the club's own depth chart page (read in full) and the NFL Week 10 injury report (all 7 pages read). Verdict rule: VERIFIED = every named player's chart placement and report status agree with the cascade; PARTLY = core order confirmed but a status is wrong, an injury detail is news-only, or a slot is contested; CONTRADICTED = chart order or a named starter's status disagrees with the cascade.
